title: Nagpur, Maharashtra — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nagpur, Maharashtra: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nagpur is a city in Maharashtra with a population of 2,800,000. The geographic center of India, known for its oranges, tiger reserves, and as the winter capital of Maharashtra. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
